description: Pub. 544 (2025), § 1250: real property (FMV $200,000, adjusted basis $120,000) for real property worth $160,000 and $40,000 cash. The § 1250 QIP given up has a basis of $15,000 and an adjusted basis of $0; § 1250 recapture $10,000; all § 1250 property received. 'Gain recognized on the like-kind exchange $40,000 or section 1250 Recapture $10,000 Less: FMV section 1250 property received (160,000) Section 1250(d)(4)(A) limit $0 The greater of these two amounts, $40,000, is the limit ... so the $10,000 section 1250 recapture is reported as ordinary income.'
